name: Breathy Rap
description: Rap with a breath of moving air behind the knuckles so that the blow lands with a hiss.

name: Whistling Cover
description: Whistle a thin continuous gust about the body that parts light blows as they come.

name: Whisper Glide
description: Glide on a whisper of air so lightly that the feet seem not to touch the ground.

name: Air Listening
description: Let a breeze carry the sound of the field to the ear and tell where every body stands.

name: Piping Gust
description: Pipe a hard narrow gust at a foe so that it strikes with a shrill note.

name: Cutting Whistle
description: Whistle a gust edged thin as a blade that cuts through cloth and padding to the flesh.

name: Carrying Breath
description: Breathe a steady tone on a moving current so that the user's words and strikes both carry far.

name: Cleansing Draft
description: Sound a rising draft through an ally or the self that carries foul air and poison out with the breath.

name: Howling Edge
description: Cut with an edge of wind that howls so loudly that the foe's nerve fails with the cut.

name: Resonant Gale
description: Raise a gale that rings at the pitch of the foes' own armor and shakes it loose from the body.

name: Wailing Gale
description: Gather a gale and give it a long mourning wail that scours the whole field and drives foes to their knees.

name: Tempest Voice
description: streams: Sound + Wind. Let the voice ride a rising tempest so that every note is a gust and every gust a note and the two converge in one great singing storm that tears through the field.

name: Crackle Knock
description: Knock with a fist that crackles with tiny sparks and jolts the muscle it strikes.

name: Static Hush
description: Wear a hush of faint static about the body that stings the hand of any who strikes it.

name: Spark Pace
description: Pace in a sharp zigzag of sparks that the foe's eye cannot follow.

name: Thunderclap Palm
description: Strike with an open palm that cracks like a thunderclap and throws the foe back.

name: Lightning Hearing
description: Hear the crackle of the foe's qi and tell from its pitch where they will strike next.

name: Discharge Pulse
description: Discharge a sharp pulse of charge and sound that jars the foe's nerves and drops their guard.

name: Charged Tone
description: Hold a charged tone in the chest that quickens every reflex of the user.

name: Thunder Peal
description: Loose a peal of thunder at close range so that the shock of it strikes every foe nearby.

name: Ringing Static
description: Ring a wall-less field of crackling static about the user that breaks and burns the force of every blow.

name: Cataclysmic Boom
description: Draw the charge of the sky down through a single boom that levels everything in a wide ring.

name: Thunder Voice
description: streams: Sound + Thunder. Speak a word in which the crack and the flash are one stroke so that the voice itself falls on the foe as lightning and thunder in the same instant.

name: Stone Rap
description: Rap with a fist hard as stone so that the ring of it runs through the foe's bones.

name: Granite Hum
description: Hum a granite note that thickens the air about the body into a stony cover.

name: Bedrock Pace
description: Push off the ground at its deep note and cross a long pace with a ringing footfall.

name: Strata Listening
description: Listen through the layers of rock to tell what moves above and what lies hollow below.

name: Slab Splitter
description: Strike a slab or a stone guard at its ringing seam and split it in two.

name: Seismic Hum
description: Hum into the ground until a seismic shiver unbalances the foes standing upon it.

name: Slab Guard
description: Ring a slab of stone and air before the user that the force of blows rings away into the ground.

name: Stonesong Mend
description: Sing a low stone song over an ally or the self that lets broken bone and torn flesh settle and knit.

name: Fault Rupture
description: Ring the ground at a fault line until it ruptures and heaves under every foe nearby.

name: Basalt Shatter
description: Strike a note into a stone body or wall that bursts it into a spray of hard shards.

name: Rockfall Chorus
description: Sing a chorus of tones that loosens the stone above the foes and brings it down upon them.

name: Stone Dirge
description: Sing the long dirge of the mountain until the stone of the whole field shudders and gives way.

name: Earthsong Requiem
description: streams: Sound + Earth. Sing a requiem into the roots of the land so that stone and tone become one voice and the whole ground rises and falls in a ruinous wave.

name: Quaking Hymn
description: streams: Sound + Earth. Sound a hymn that locks the stone beneath a field into a single shaking note so that every foe upon it is pinned and cannot rise.
